faqs.question: How do I send money?
faqs.answer: Go to Home → Send Money. Enter the amount, view the real-time exchange rate, lock the rate, fill in recipient details (name, phone in +250 format), choose delivery method (Mobile Money or Bank Transfer), then complete payment.

faqs.question: What is the maximum I can send?
faqs.answer: The maximum per transaction is 5,000,000 RWF.

faqs.question: What are the transfer fees?
faqs.answer: Flat fees apply depending on your currency: 5 PLN, 2 USD, 2 EUR, or 2 GBP per transaction.

faqs.question: What payment methods can I use to send money?
faqs.answer: You can pay using Card, BLIK (Poland), Apple Pay, or Google Pay.

faqs.question: What delivery methods are available for recipients?
faqs.answer: Recipients can receive money via Mobile Money or Bank Transfer.

faqs.question: How long does a transfer take?
faqs.answer: Mobile Money transfers are usually instant. Bank transfers may take 1-2 business days.

faqs.question: What phone number format does the recipient need?
faqs.answer: Rwanda phone numbers must be in +250 format, e.g. +250 78 000 0000.

faqs.question: What is a rate lock?
faqs.answer: When you send money, Amo Pay locks the exchange rate for 5 minutes (300 seconds) so it doesn't change while you complete the transaction. If it expires, simply refresh to get a new rate.

faqs.question: Can I get a receipt after sending money?
faqs.answer: Yes. After every successful transaction you can generate and share a receipt directly from the app.

faqs.question: What currencies does Amo Pay support?
faqs.answer: Amo Pay supports RWF, USD, EUR, GBP, and PLN.

faqs.question: How do I exchange currencies?
faqs.answer: Go to Home → Exchange. Select the currencies you want to swap, enter the amount, review the rate and confirm.

faqs.question: Are exchange rates real-time?
faqs.answer: Yes. Amo Pay provides daily rate updates and real-time rates when initiating a transfer or exchange.

faqs.question: What happens if my rate expires?
faqs.answer: Rate locks last 5 minutes. If it expires before you complete the transaction, simply refresh to get the latest rate.

faqs.question: How do I become a merchant?
faqs.answer: Go to Profile → Become a Merchant. Fill in your Business Name, Business Phone, and optional physical address. You can also add your MoMo or Airtel codes.

faqs.question: What tools do merchants get?
faqs.answer: Merchants get access to: a personalized QR code for receiving payments, a Merchant Scanner to process payments quickly, and detailed analytics for their business.

faqs.question: How do customers pay me as a merchant?
faqs.answer: Share your Merchant QR code. Customers scan it to pay you instantly through Amo Pay.

faqs.question: Can I track my merchant sales?
faqs.answer: Yes. The Analytics section gives you detailed merchant-specific reports and transaction history.

faqs.question: What is KYC?
faqs.answer: KYC stands for Know Your Customer. It is an identity verification process required for higher transaction limits and enhanced account security.

faqs.question: What documents do I need for KYC?
faqs.answer: You need: a National ID or Passport (front and back photos), a clear selfie in a well-lit environment, and a Proof of Address document.

faqs.question: How long does KYC verification take?
faqs.answer: KYC review usually takes 24-48 hours after submission.

faqs.question: My KYC was rejected, what do I do?
faqs.answer: Make sure your photos are clear, well-lit, and all edges of your ID are fully visible. Retake photos if needed and resubmit. If it keeps failing, contact support.

faqs.question: Can I use the app without completing KYC?
faqs.answer: You can browse the app but you will not be able to send money or access full features until KYC is completed and verified.

faqs.question: How do I log in securely?
faqs.answer: Amo Pay supports Face ID and Biometric Authentication for fast and secure login.

faqs.question: What are the password requirements?
faqs.answer: Your password must be 8-128 characters and include at least one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, one number, and one special character.

faqs.question: Is my data safe?
faqs.answer: Yes. Amo Pay uses SecureStore to protect your tokens and sensitive data. Never share your OTP or password with anyone.

faqs.question: What should I do if I see suspicious activity?
faqs.answer: Contact support immediately at support@amopay.com. Do not share any personal details with unknown contacts.

faqs.question: My account is suspended, what do I do?
faqs.answer: Contact support at support@amopay.com for assistance. Do not attempt to create a new account.

faqs.question: My payment was declined, what should I do?
faqs.answer: Check with your bank for any limits. You can also try an alternative payment method like BLIK, Apple Pay, or Google Pay.

faqs.question: I have insufficient balance, what do I do?
faqs.answer: Top up your wallet balance first before attempting the transaction again.

faqs.question: My session expired, what should I do?
faqs.answer: Simply log in again. Amo Pay will automatically refresh your session securely.

faqs.question: Can I cancel or reverse a transaction?
faqs.answer: Transactions cannot be reversed directly in the app. Please contact support at support@amopay.com as soon as possible if you need help with a transaction.

faqs.question: What is Amo Pay?
faqs.answer: Amo Pay is a comprehensive digital wallet and financial services platform designed for seamless money transfers, currency exchange, and merchant services, primarily serving Rwanda and diaspora communities.

faqs.question: Which languages does Amo Pay support?
faqs.answer: Amo Pay supports English and Kinyarwanda. The AMO Assistant replies in whichever language you use.

faqs.question: How do I contact support?
faqs.answer: Email us at support@amopay.com or call +250 700 000 000. Support is available Monday to Friday, 8AM to 6PM Kigali time.

faqs.question: What is the AMO Assistant?
faqs.answer: AMO Assistant is your built-in AI helper. It guides you through the app, answers questions in English or Kinyarwanda, and helps you with all Amo Pay features 24/7.

faqs.question: How do I view my transaction history?
faqs.answer: Go to Home → History to see all your past transactions, receipts, and detailed records.
